PAMILYAR KA BA SA LUGAR NA ITO?

Noong itinayo ang gusali ng Manila Film Center ng 1981, naganap ang aksidente na kung saan nasa higit 160 katao ang ang naipit at nabaon nang buhay sa semento matapos bumagsak ang scaffolding habang umano’y nagmamadali sa pagtatapos ng gusali.

Hanggang ngayon, sinasabing may mga ungol, iyak, at kaluskos na maririnig sa kalaliman ng gabi kung mapapadaan sa nasabing lugar. 

#LugarNgKatatakutan #DZRH

data.english_translation: DO YOU KNOW IN THIS LUAR? When the building of the Manila Film Center of 1981 was built, the accident occurred in which more than 160 people were trapped and buried alive in the cement after the fall of scaffolding as the building was said to hurry to its end. To this day, it is said, there are growls, cries, and culls that can be heard in the middle of night as it goes by the previous site. #LNGEN SKANKOD #DZHH.
